title: Hourly timestamp record
description: The subject of the hour (the latest witnessed tree head of every log and a hash link to the previous hourly record), its SHA-256 imprint, and the RFC 3161 token obtained for that imprint. Stored at data/v1/timestamps/YYYY/MM/DD/HHZ.json, next to the raw TimeStampResp in HHZ.tsr, and never rewritten.

imprint.description: SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 (JCS) serialization of subject: the message imprint sent to the TSA. Because subject holds only ASCII strings, integers, objects and null, `jq -jcS .subject` produces the same bytes.

token.description: The accepted token, or null when every provider failed this hour (the record is still written so the gap is visible and the chain stays unbroken).

attempts.description: Providers that failed before the accepted one (or all of them, when token is null), in the order they were tried.

cia.description: The latest CIA run record at the time of the hour and the SHA-256 of its bytes. Absent in records written before CIA reporting began; when present it is covered by the imprint like every other field.

logs.description: For each log, the latest witness record at the time of the hour.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the bytes of the witness record file.

prev.description: The previous hourly record and the SHA-256 of its bytes, or null for the first one.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the bytes of the .tsr file.

genTime.description: TSTInfo.genTime, truncated to seconds: the time the TSA attests.

tsa.description: Subject of the certificate that signed the token, for display (an RFC 2253 string; some authorities' names run to several hundred characters).

checks.description: What the witness checked before writing the token.
